Meeting notes
Humne naye product features aur marketing strategy par vistaar se charcha ki. Meeting mukhya
conference room mein hui aur ismein Development, Marketing aur Product teams ke pramukh shaamil hue. Mukhya
dhyaan user experience ko behtar banaane aur shuruaati market test se mile feedback ko shaamil karne par tha.

Action items:
  - go-to-market strategy ko final karne ke liye marketing team se follow-up karein. Ismein campaign launch ki
    timeline tay karna aur mukhya marketing channel pehchaanna shaamil hai.

  - Prastaavit features ki takneeki vyavahaaryata par charcha ke liye development team ke saath meeting schedule karein.
    Development timeline aur sansadhanon ke aavantan ka aakalan karna bahut zaroori hai.

  - Charcha kiye gaye naye features aur timeline ke hisaab se product roadmap update karein. Yeh updated roadmap
    paardarshita aur taalmel ke liye sabhi stakeholders ke saath share kiya jaayega.

  - Maujooda market trends aur pratispardhi products ka vishleshan karke ek competitive analysis report taiyaar karein.
    Isse hamare product ki sahi positioning mein madad milegi.

  - Prototype par seedha feedback lene ke liye chuninda users ke saath ek focus group session aayojit karein.
    Launch se pehle aakhri badlaav karne mein yeh feedback bahut kaam aayega.

  - Meeting mein pehchaane gaye sambhavit jokhimon se nipatne ke liye ek aakasmik yojana banaayein. Ismein
    supply chain mein rukaavat, takneeki chunautiyaan aur market mein pravesh ki baadhaayein shaamil hain.

Agle kadam mein har team apne saunpe gaye kaamon par kaam karegi aur do hafte baad
pragati ki jaankari ke liye phir milegi. Lakshya timaahi ke ant tak product launch karna hai, aur
is timeline par tike rehne ki poori koshish ki jaayegi.

Project ki yojana mein ye kadam shaamil hain:
  - Project ka daayra tay karna, jismein seemaayein aur jo shaamil nahin hai woh bhi ho
  - Mukhya stakeholders ki pehchaan karna aur communication plan banaana
  - Milestone aur vyavahaarik deadline ke saath project timeline banaana
  - Sambhavit seemaaon aur uplabdhata ko dhyaan mein rakhte hue sansadhan aavantit karna
  - Niyamit check-in aur zaroorat ke hisaab se badlaav ke saath pragati par nazar rakhna
  - Sambhavit samasyaon ki pehchaan karne aur unhein kam karne ke liye risk management plan laagu karna
  - Development ke mukhya charanon par quality assurance testing ki yojana banaana
  - Project closure ki taiyaari karna, jismein documentation aur handover ki prakriya shaamil hai

Team Building Activities Plan
Is document ka uddeshya team building gatividhiyon ki ek series ki rooprekha dena hai, jinka maqsad team mein ekjutta, communication aur kul milaakar utpaadakta badhaana hai. Ye gatividhiyaan is tarah banaayi gayi hain ki sabko shaamil karein, dilchasp hon aur team ke har sadasya ke liye faaydemand hon.

Activity 1: Problem-solving workshop
  - Vivaran: Ek workshop jismein teams ko unke kaam se jude kai samasyaon ke udaharan diye jaate hain. Teams vichaar-manthan karke apne samadhaan pesh karengi.
  - Uddeshya: Samasya suljhaane ka kaushal badhaana aur naye tareeke se sochne ko badhaava dena.
  - Jagah: Conference room A

Activity 2: Outdoor team challenge
  - Vivaran: Teams kai outdoor chunautiyon mein muqaabla karti hain jinmein teamwork, shaareerik mehnat aur rananeetik soch ki zaroorat hoti hai.
  - Uddeshya: Team ke aapsi rishte mazboot karna aur shaareerik sehat ko badhaava dena.
  - Jagah: Green Park
  - Tareekh: 2023-11-22
  - Samay: 09:00 - 15:00

Activity 3: Team lunch and learn
  - Vivaran: Ek anaupchaarik session jismein team ke sadasya lunch ke dauraan apna gyaan saajha karte hain. Har session mein team ka koi alag sadasya apni pasand ke vishay par presentation deta hai.
  - Uddeshya: Seekhne aur gyaan baantne ki sanskriti ko badhaava dena.
  - Jagah: Office cafeteria
  - Tareekh: Har Guruvaar
  - Samay: 12:00 - 13:00

Activity 4: Creative workshop
  - Vivaran: Ek sthaaniya kalaakaar ki aguvaai mein workshop, jismein team ke sadasya painting, moortikala ya drawing jaisi rachnaatmak gatividhiyaan karte hain.
  - Uddeshya: Rachnaatmakta ko badhaava dena aur kaam se ek sukoon bhara break dena.
  - Jagah: Art Center Downtown
  - Tareekh: 2024-12-06
  - Samay: 14:00 - 16:00

Timaahi lakshyon ka update
Yeh document hamare timaahi lakshyon ki disha mein hui pragati aur agli timaahi ke uddeshyon ki rooprekha deta hai. Yeh hamari uplabdhiyon par ek nazar aur aage ki kaaryayojana dono hai.

Q1 ki uplabdhiyaan:
  - Nayi product line safaltapoorvak launch ki, jisse bikri mein 20% ki badhotari hui.
  - Customer service ka response time 30% behtar kiya.
  - Chaar naye engineer bharti karke development team badhaayi.

Q2 ke uddeshya:
  - Do naye baazaaron mein pravesh karke market share badhaana.
  - Kaam ki jaankari jutaane ke liye naya customer feedback system laagu karna.
  - Sansadhanon ke behtar aavantan se operating laagat kam karna.

Chunautiyaan:
  - Supply chain mein deri se hamare inventory level par asar pada hai.
  - Hamare mukhya baazaar mein badhti pratispardha ke kaaran pricing strategy ki sameeksha zaroori hai.

Kaaryayojana:
  - Deri ki pehchaan karne aur use kam karne ke liye supply chain partners se baat karna.
  - Pricing strategy mein badlaav ke liye market analysis karna.
  - Pratispardhiyon se alag dikhne ke liye hamare product ki khaas visheshtaaon par kendrit marketing campaign shuru karna.

Hamare saalana lakshyon ke liye Q2 ke uddeshyon ki safalta bahut aham hai. Team leads in uddeshyon ki pragati par har hafte update denge. Team ke sabhi sadasyon ko bataayi gayi chunautiyon se paar paane ke liye apne sujhaav aur yogdaan dene ke liye protsaahit kiya jaata hai.

Lucas ki pasandeeda recipes

1. Chocolate chip cookies
   Saamagri:
     - 1 cup makkhan, naram kiya hua
     - 1 cup safed cheeni
     - 1 cup dabaakar bhari brown sugar
     - 2 ande
     - 2 chhote chammach vanilla extract
     - 3 cup maida
     - 1 chhota chammach baking soda
     - 2 chhote chammach garam paani
     - 1/2 chhota chammach namak
     - 2 cup semisweet chocolate chips
   Vidhi:
     1. Oven ko 350 degree F (175 degree C) par preheat karein.
     2. Makkhan, safed cheeni aur brown sugar ko chikna hone tak phentein.
     3. Ek-ek karke ande phentkar milaayein, phir vanilla milaayein.
     4. Baking soda ko garam paani mein gholein. Namak ke saath ise ghol mein milaayein.
     5. Maida, chocolate chips aur meve milaayein. Bade chammach se bina chiknaai lagi tray par rakhein.
     6. Preheat kiye oven mein lagbhag 10 minute tak ya kinaare achhe se bhoore hone tak bake karein.

2. Spaghetti carbonara
   Saamagri:
     - 200 gram spaghetti
     - 100 gram pancetta
     - 2 bade ande
     - 50 gram pecorino cheese
     - 50 gram parmesan
     - Taazi pisi kaali mirch
     - Samudri namak
     - Lahsun ki 1 kali, chhili hui aur saabut
     - 50 gram bina namak ka makkhan
   Vidhi:
     1. Ek bade pateele mein paani ubaalne rakhein.
     2. Pancetta ki upari parat hataakar use baareek kaat lein.
     3. Dono cheese baareek kaddukas karke mila lein.
     4. Ek madhyam katore mein ande phentein, thodi taazi pisi kaali mirch daalein aur sab alag rakh dein.
     5. Ubalte paani mein 1 chhota chammach namak daalein, spaghetti daalein, aur paani mein phir se ubaal aane par dheemi aanch par pakaate rahein.
     6. Chaaku ke phalak se lahsun ko halka-sa daba dein.
     7. Ek madhyam frying pan mein makkhan pighlaayein, lahsun aur pancetta daalein, aur madhyam aanch par pakaayein.
     8. Pancetta ke neeche aanch dheemi rakhein. Pasta taiyaar hone par use pasta fork ya chimte se paani se nikaalkar pancetta wale pan mein daalein.
     9. Spaghetti aur pancetta wala pan aanch se hata lein.
     10. Jaldi se ande aur cheese daalein. Chimte ya lambe fork se sab milaayein, spaghetti ko uthaate hue taaki woh ande ke mishran mein aasaani se mil jaaye, jo gaadha to ho par phate nahin, aur sab par achhi tarah lag jaaye.
     11. Bachi hui cheese thodi chhidakkar aur upar se kaali mirch kaddukas karke turant parosein.

3. Chicken curry
   Saamagri:
     - 2 bade chammach vegetable oil
     - 1 bada pyaaz, kata hua
     - Lahsun ki 2 kaliyaan, baareek kati
     - 1 bada chammach adrak, baareek kata
     - 2 bade chammach curry powder
     - 1 chhota chammach pisa jeera
     - 1 chhota chammach pisi haldi
     - 1 chhota chammach pisa dhaniya
     - 1 chhota chammach laal mirch (cayenne)
     - 1 (14.5 ounce) dibba kate tamatar
     - 1 (14 ounce) dibba nariyal ka doodh
     - 2 pound bina haddi aur bina khaal ka chicken breast, chhote tukdon mein kata
     - Swaadanusaar namak aur kaali mirch
     - 1 bada chammach kata hara dhaniya
   Vidhi:
     1. Ek badi kadaahi mein madhyam aanch par vegetable oil garam karein. Pyaaz aur lahsun daalein, aur naram hone tak pakaayein.
     2. Adrak, curry powder, jeera, haldi, dhaniya aur laal mirch milaayein; 1 minute pakaayein.
     3. Tamatar aur nariyal ka doodh daalein; ubaal aane dein.

def sanitize(text: str) -> str:
    # Index karne se pehle aam injection marker hata dein. Yahan hum jaan-boojhkar
    # case ko nazarandaaz karte hain; hamlaavar ise badalte rehte hain.
    patterns = [

        r'you are now in developer mode',

    ]
    for p in patterns:
        text = re.sub(p, '[redacted]', text, flags=re.I)
    return text
